# Behavioral constraints are documented but not enforced by the interface

Key pipeline invariants and expectations (for example: Extractor must not emit Entities; LLMProvider must perform schema-validated completion; Emitter must operate only on Knowledge IR) are expressed in docstrings but not enforced by the Protocol method signatures or types. Implementers can violate these contracts at runtime, leading to integration errors downstream.
